lines.text: The psalm tells everyone to thank the LORD, and the redeemed He gathered from east, west, north, and south.
Wanderers in desert wastelands cried out to the LORD, and He led them on a straight path to a city.
Prisoners in darkness cried out, and the LORD broke their chains and broke down the gates of stone.
Fools who loathed all food cried out, and the LORD sent a prophet and healed them from the Pit.
Traders at sea faced a tempest, and the LORD calmed the storm to a whisper and guided them to harbor.
